basic_details.job_title: IIEST Shibpur Senior Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 7 Posts
basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Engineering Science and Technology, Shibpur (IIEST Shibpur), Howrah, West Bengal, has invited applications for 7 posts of Senior Assistant under Advt No. RO/NO/26/34. The online application is open from 9 November 2026 to 9 December 2026.

how_to_apply: Fill the online application form on the SAMARTH portal https://iiestsnt.samarth.edu.in by 09.12.2026, 11:55 pm.
Pay the application fee as per instructions given within the SAMARTH Recruitment portal.
After final submission, download the filled application form.
Make a single PDF of the form with self-attested photocopies of the certificates/testimonials/documents uploaded on SAMARTH.
Submit the single PDF through the Google Form https://forms.gle/eTbtScUCrWzcE3Xt9 by 14.12.2026, 11:55 pm.
Employed candidates also send the application through proper channel to the Registrar, superscribing 'Application for the Post of Senior Assistant'.
important_instructions: The complete application form with all supporting documents (the Google Form PDF) must be produced at the written test and skill test. All original testimonials/documents are to be produced before the written test and skill test. No TA or DA will be paid for appearing in the written test and/or skill test. Employed candidates must send an advance copy online and apply through proper channel. Queries may be sent to [email protected] with subject 'Recruitment for the Post of Senior Assistant'. The Institute reserves the right to fill or not to fill any or all of the advertised posts.

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Senior secondary (10+2) from a recognized board; Minimum typing speed of 35 w.p.m.; Proficiency in Computer Word Processing and Spread Sheet Age limit: Maximum 33 years (as on the last date for submission of the application form) Age relaxation: Departmental Candidates Up to five years in accordance with the instructions or orders issued by the Central Government, Others Relaxation, if any, as per Central Government Rules Other conditions: Only Indian nationals may apply. content_sections.heading: How Will IIEST Shibpur Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Stage-I: Written Test Stage-II: Skill Test (qualifying) Stage-I Written Test marks alone are used to prepare the merit list. Stage-II Skill Test is qualifying: minimum typing speed of 35 w.p.m. and proficiency in Computer Word Processing and Spreadsheet. Final merit list is subject to qualifying the skill test and the recommendation of the Selection Committee. Tie: more correct marks in the written test, then higher age, then higher percentage in the minimum qualifying examination (top five subjects including one core language).

content_sections.heading: IIEST Shibpur Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: Qualifying in the Skill Test is mandatory to be considered for selection.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Downloaded filled application form from the SAMARTH portal Self-attested photocopies of certificates/testimonials/documents uploaded on SAMARTH, as a single PDF Valid caste certificate (SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/EWS), if applicable; OBC (NCL)/EWS issued on or after April 1, 2026 Proof of disability (not less than 40%) for PwD candidates No Objection Certificate from present employer for employed candidates, at the written test and skill test Updated Vigilance Clearance Certificate at document verification, for employed candidates if selected

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIEST Shibpur Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Fill the online application form on the SAMARTH portal https://iiestsnt.samarth.edu.in by 09.12.2026, 11:55 pm. Pay the application fee as per instructions given within the SAMARTH Recruitment portal. After final submission, download the filled application form. Make a single PDF of the form with self-attested photocopies of the certificates/testimonials/documents uploaded on SAMARTH. Submit the single PDF through the Google Form https://forms.gle/eTbtScUCrWzcE3Xt9 by 14.12.2026, 11:55 pm. Employed candidates also send the application through proper channel to the Registrar, superscribing 'Application for the Post of Senior Assistant'.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIEST Shibpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 9 December 2026. Applications opened on 9 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in IIEST Shibpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 7 vacancies for Senior Assistant.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for IIEST Shibpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 9 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: General/EWS/OBC(NCL): Rs. 1500. SC/ST/PwD: Rs. 1000.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 33 years (as on the last date for submission of the application form). Relaxation: Departmental Candidates Up to five years in accordance with the instructions or orders issued by the Central Government, Others Relaxation, if any, as per Central Government Rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Pay Level 04 (7th CPC); PB-1 Rs.5,200 - 20,200 with Grade Pay Rs.2400 (6th CPC).

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Senior secondary (10+2) from a recognized board with a minimum typing speed of 35 w.p.m. and proficiency in Computer Word Processing and Spread Sheet.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Only Indian nationals may apply. Applicants should be physically fit and mentally sound. Degrees/diplomas/certificates must be from Universities/Institutions recognized by the Competent authority. OBC (NCL)/EWS certificate must be issued on or after April 1, 2026, otherwise the application is considered under UR.

faq.answer: Applications submitted only through the SAMARTH portal or only through the Google Form will not be considered. Applications received through the Google Form after 14.12.2026, 11:55 pm will not be considered. Incomplete applications or applications not through proper channel will be summarily rejected.
